jobs.title: Lead Security Engineer (Threat Detection)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

You will lead the team that stands between adversaries and 135 million customers. The Threat Detection team proactively hunts for security threats and builds robust, actionable detections to protect both customers and Nubankers — operating as a true Security Operations Center, backed by strong engineering power and intelligence from our internal Threat Intelligence team.

As Lead, you own the strategic Threat Detection program end to end: intelligence gathering, threat modeling, detection engineering, AI-assisted analysis, Purple Team validation, incident response and post-incident learning. Your goal is to make sure effective detection rules, actionable insights and AI-enabled security capabilities are in place and aligned with industry best practices, so that adversary activity across Nubank's environment is identified, prevented and detected before it reaches our customers.

You'll also build and lead a high-performing team, support Security leadership in building a world-class security organization, and ensure detection processes meet auditing requirements and support clear communication with regulatory bodies.

Learn more about Nubank Infosec: https://blog.nubank.com.br/infosec-nubank-protecao-dados/

You'll be responsible for

  • Analyzing cyber threat intelligence, emerging attack trends and security telemetry to develop robust detections and threat models, while reducing false positives and improving the efficiency of security operations.

  • Leveraging AI and machine learning across the detection lifecycle — anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, alert triage, threat intelligence enrichment, investigation prioritization and response automation — and leading their adoption so these capabilities are reliable, measurable and secure.

  • Defining validation, quality, explainability and security controls for AI-assisted capabilities, accounting for risks such as inaccurate outputs, data leakage, prompt injection, model manipulation and adversarial evasion.

  • Leading Purple Team activities with Offensive Security, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response and Engineering: translating adversary behaviors into realistic attack simulations, adversary emulation plans and detection validation scenarios mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Identifying detection and prevention gaps, validating security controls, measuring detection coverage and driving remediation through actionable improvement plans.

  • Establishing feedback loops between offensive and defensive teams so lessons from simulations and real incidents continuously improve detection, investigation and response.

  • Defining success criteria and tracking metrics: detection coverage, validation success rate, false-positive reduction, investigation time, response efficiency and remediation cycle time.

  • Building and leading the team — mentoring engineers and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning.

  • Partnering closely with Security Engineering, Threat Intelligence, Software Engineering and Incident Response to build scalable solutions for analyzing security event data and a resilient security architecture aligned with Business Unit strategy.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Solid hands-on experience with Threat Hunting and Incident Response, including handling and resolving complex security incidents.

  • Experience as a technical leader in the identification, analysis and response to complex security threats, providing mentorship and guidance to team members.

  • Experience developing and maintaining detection-as-code solutions to automate threat identification and response.

  • Proven experience in information security operations, with expertise in managing, analyzing and deriving insights from logs and other security-related data.

  • Proficiency with SIEM and EDR tools, and with security platforms such as WAFs, firewalls (e.g. Palo Alto, Cisco ASA) and IDS/IPS.

  • Experience using and integrating threat intelligence feeds to improve detection.

  • Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing security-related databases.

  • Knowledge of cloud security principles and experience securing cloud environments across providers (e.g. AWS).

  • Track record of developing processes, measuring results and delivering continuous improvement.

  • Strong communication skills, a genuine team player and team leader, able to thrive in a team where diversity is key to high performance.

  • Advanced English.

Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

  • São Paulo, Brazil

  • Campinas, Brazil

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (Blockchain Security)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

The Blockchain Security team sits within the Product Security & Assurance BA, part of the Information Technology and Security (ITSec) BU. Our mission is to support the security of Nu's crypto operation. In the context of Nu's global expansion, keeping these products secure, and demonstrably compliant with financial regulators, is a direct condition for our ability to operate and grow.

As a Senior Security Engineer on this team, you own the security posture of our crypto operation. You are the person who thinks like an attacker so our products can withstand real ones: finding vulnerabilities before adversaries do, embedding product security into how crypto products are designed and built, and making sure our controls satisfy both internal risk standards and external regulatory requirements. You won't just run security tools. You'll build and operate the ones that protect our crypto products, from hardened ingress and monitoring/alerting systems to secure secret-management and automated security-review tooling. Your work directly protects customer funds and Nu's ability to run crypto products at scale.

 

You'll be responsible for

  • Applying an offensive security mindset to our crypto and blockchain products: simulating attacks, running penetration tests and security assessments, and turning findings into concrete mitigations.

  • Driving product security across the crypto portfolio: threat modeling, security-by-design reviews, and embedding secure practices into the development lifecycle.

  • Building, operating, and improving in-house security services and tooling that integrate directly with our crypto products, for example hardened ingress/edge controls, security monitoring and anomaly alerting, secure secret-management, and automated security-review tooling.

  • Ensuring our crypto operation meets regulatory requirements: mapping controls to applicable regulations, supporting audits, and producing the evidence regulators and internal risk teams expect.

  • Collaborating with product and engineering teams to design secure blockchain architecture and embed security-by-design into new products.

  • Contributing to security policies, standards, and guidelines that govern blockchain security operations.

  • Using AI to raise the leverage and quality of security work: building and running AI-assisted tooling for tasks like threat modeling, code and vulnerability review, and attack simulation, and helping the team push the frontier of what AI-first security engineering looks like.

  • Staying current on emerging attack vectors, exploits, and best practices across product and blockchain security, and sharing that knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a person who has

Must have

  • Strong product security and/or offensive security background (penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, attack simulation, incident response).

  • Experience embedding security into product development: threat modeling, secure SDLC, security-by-design reviews.

  • Hands-on software engineering ability: you can build and operate security services and automation, not just use off-the-shelf tools. Comfortable writing production code (we work heavily in Clojure; strong experience in any modern language plus willingness to learn Clojure is fine).

  • Solid working knowledge of blockchain and cryptocurrency fundamentals, including how blockchains, wallets, keys, and smart contracts work, enough to reason about their security (expert-level depth not required, but real familiarity is).

  • Strong knowledge of recent and past attack vectors and exploits, and how to remediate them.

  • Experience with security frameworks such as OWASP and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).

  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering: using coding agents and LLMs in daily work, with good judgment about where they help, where they don't, and how to review their output critically.

  • Familiarity with AWS, and solid grounding in operating systems, networks, databases, and infrastructure architecture.

  • Ability to work autonomously and proactively, strong analytical/problem-solving skills, and clear written and spoken English for technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to have

  • Deeper knowledge of blockchain/crypto internals: consensus algorithms, cryptographic protocols, smart contracts.

  • Experience auditing smart contracts (e.g. Solidity) or working with DeFi protocols.

  • Experience integrating with third-party crypto custody/infrastructure providers (e.g. Fireblocks, Circle, and similar).

  • Exposure to regulatory or compliance requirements in a financial or crypto context.

  • Experience with bug bounties and/or CTFs.

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or Certified Blockchain Security Professional.

Location for this opportunity

  • São Paulo, Brazil 

  • Campinas, Brazil 

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil 

  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil 

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

 

Work Model for this Role

Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

 

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Engineering at Nubank

At Nubank, software engineers sit at the intersection of data, intelligence, and scale. We build systems that process millions of decisions daily, from fraud detection to credit modeling and increasingly, we do this powered by AI. Machine learning is embedded across our core products: in how we assess risk, personalize experiences, and automate decisions at scale. Engineers here don't just consume AI capabilities; they help shape how intelligence is built, deployed, and maintained in production.

We do it with engineering rigor, autonomy, and a deep focus on impact. Our engineers work across the full spectrum: designing data pipelines and architectures, deploying and maintaining ML models in production, and building the distributed systems and platforms that power our products. We value small, independent teams that move fast, own their decisions end-to-end, and hold themselves to a high bar for quality and craft.

We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices across our entire stack. While we value candidates familiar with our technologies, we're confident that engineers who join Nubank will learn and grow alongside our team:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, leveraging functional programming and hexagonal architecture

  • High-throughput event-driven architectures for inter-service communication

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into cloud-native infrastructure

  • Distributed transactional systems built on Datomic, modeling complex business domains with immutable data and strong consistency

  • Modern data platforms built on ETL/ELT best practices, with robust monitoring and observability

Our Software Engineers

  • Work with large scale distributed systems

  • Collaborate with building microservices

  • Design, build and maintain robust data pipelines, distributed systems and ML-enabled solutions, ensuring reliability, scalability and performance at scale

  • Deploy and maintain ML models in both batch and real-time scenarios, integrating them with other systems and monitoring through operational and business metrics

  • Lead data and engineering projects end-to-end — from requirements gathering and stakeholder alignment to delivery and iteration

  • Contribute to the design, documentation, maintenance and optimization of our data codebase, platforms and tooling

  • Translate business needs into data products and technical solutions aligned with Nubank's architecture and long-term strategy

  • Partner with technical and business stakeholders to define strategies and deliver high-impact solutions

  • Share knowledge, mentor peers and contribute to engineering and data literacy initiatives across Nubank

What We're Looking For

  • Programming experience in one or more general-purpose languages (e.g. Python, Clojure, Scala, Java)

  • Familiarity with analytical data environments and data engineering concepts: pipelines, ETL/ELT, data modeling and storage

  • Understanding of ML model lifecycle, from training and evaluation to deployment and monitoring

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices and asynchronous architectures

  • Strong communication skills to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders

  • Passion for building high-quality software and data products

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or Azure

  • Knowledge of data architecture patterns (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Mart)

  • Familiarity with ML frameworks and feature engineering pipelines

  • Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau or similar)

  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices: testing, clean code, documentation

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance, Medical Plan and Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo – Our learning platform

  • Extended Parental Leave, Daycare Allowance and Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration.

For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (CloudNetwork)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Every transaction at Nubank travels across a network before it reaches a customer. As we grow across countries, accounts, regions and hybrid environments, the connectivity layer underneath has to stay fast, segmented, auditable and cheap to run — while never becoming the thing that takes the platform down.

 

As a Lead Software Engineer on a Cloud Network platform engineering team, you set and evolve the technical direction for how Nubank connects its cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments. You own problems whose scope spreads across several teams and business units, and you are expected to bring structure to ambiguity rather than wait for it to be resolved for you.

 

This is an IC6 role: you lead through technical depth, design authority and influence rather than direct reports. The goal you own is a cloud network platform that scales with the business, holds up under audit, and gets simpler over time instead of more complex.

You'll be responsible for

  • Setting and evolving the technical direction of the cloud network platform owned by your team, aligning with Nubank's canonical approaches and contributing back to the broader technical community.

  • Leading high-level and low-level design for connectivity patterns across multi-account, multi-region, multi-geo and hybrid-cloud topologies, independently making sound architectural decisions in multi-component, multi-team designs.

  • Managing complex network projects and processes end to end — working independently, coordinating across subjects and stakeholders, and escalating for managerial support in a timely way rather than reactively.

  • Proactively reducing long-term complexity through simplification, consolidation, deprecation and paved roads, explicitly balancing scalability, maintainability and cost, and considering both human and AI interaction with the platform.

  • Owning the operational health of the network platform in your team's scope: leading complex incident response (diagnosis, coordination, resolution), driving complex postmortems, and owning the short- and long-term tech debt strategy that comes out of them.

  • Promoting a culture of safe change — feature flags, gradual rollout, monitoring, fast rollback — applied to network changes, and driving simplification and cost optimization across the topology.

  • Setting and enforcing quality standards for the team's automation and infrastructure code: testing practices, code review bar, reusable modules, and anticipation of quality and maintainability needs coming from business strategy.

  • Defining observability for the platform — robust monitoring, controls and SLAs that surface issues proactively rather than after customer impact.

  • Bringing a strong end-to-end domain understanding: tracing a business process from product through the transactional path down to the network and data layers, and understanding how network design choices propagate through it.

  • Owning the network security posture of your scope, including PCI DSS or equivalent standards, segmentation, and controls that hold up under audit.

  • Evaluating buy vs. build options and new products and technologies, being data-driven about stability, reliability, scalability and cost before committing to a solution.

  • Mentoring IC4/IC5 engineers on the broader system landscape, design reasoning and operational practice, and raising the bar of the people around you.

  • Participating in hiring as a core part of the role, contributing to function-wide taskforces and initiatives, and documenting decisions so that knowledge travels across teams, not just within yours.

We are looking for a person who has

  • CCIE, CCNP or equivalent experience — you are comfortable designing, building, implementing, maintaining and troubleshooting complex, large-scale networking infrastructures.

  • Solid hands-on experience in infrastructure automation and cloud computing (AWS preferred), with depth in AWS networking services — Transit Gateway, VPC design, Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Route 53, NAT/egress patterns, network firewalls — or similar technologies.

  • Deep experience planning, deploying and troubleshooting network solutions at scale: IP address management, BGP and dynamic routing, firewalls, load balancers, routers and switches, and hybrid connectivity.

  • Strong coding skills (python, .Net. Java, Go etc.)

  • Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis for high-impact, ambiguous failures across team boundaries.

  • Strong leadership: you confidently lead complex projects that carry ambiguity and require strategic thinking, with or without formal authority.

  • Experienced communication: you convey complex technical messages clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences, adjusting depth and examples to the room, and you facilitate productive discussion rather than just presenting.

  • Strategic acumen and long-term perspective: you connect network platform decisions to business drivers such as operational efficiency, reliability and cost, link 6–12 month initiatives to the broader organizational strategy, and anticipate cross-team impact and trade-offs.

  • An analytical profile: you go after root causes and propose solutions that hold, working creatively and analytically in a continuous improvement environment.


    Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

  • Miami, United States

  • Washigton DC, United States

  • Durham, United States


Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Lead Business Control Officer - Global Credit Card
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

As a Lead Business Control Officer (BCO) for the Global Credit Card business, you will play a critical role in strengthening Nu’s first line of defense and enabling sustainable growth of our credit card portfolio globally. You will partner closely with senior leaders across Global Credit Card, Product, Operations, and Risk to proactively identify, assess, and manage non-financial risks, ensuring that business objectives are achieved with a strong and efficient control environment.

You will be a hands-on leader, setting the bar for risk excellence while enabling innovation. You will help establish and continuously evolve the BCO model for Global Credit Card, embedding risk ownership in the first line, challenging how we work today, and helping us build best-in-class risk management practices.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Acting as the primary first-line risk partner for the Global Credit Card business, balancing risk management with business objectives and customer impact.

  • Driving a thorough understanding of end-to-end processes, risks, and controls across the Global Credit Card lifecycle, from product design and onboarding to servicing, collections, and support.

  • Designing, assessing, and continuously improving internal controls to ensure risks are identified, mitigated, and monitored effectively.

  • Leading and coordinating first-line risk management activities, including risk and control self-assessments (RCSA), loss and risk event management, issue remediation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Ensuring strong governance, risk, and compliance practices in alignment with internal policies, global frameworks, and applicable external regulations.

  • Supporting product and feature development by bringing a proactive risk lens to strategic decisions, business cases, and go-to-market plans.

  • Defining, tracking, and reporting meaningful risk and control metrics (KPIs/KRIs) that enable effective monitoring of the control environment and timely decision-making.

  • Building and running pragmatic, non-bureaucratic governance forums that bring together key stakeholders to discuss risks, controls, incidents, and remediation plans.

  • Preparing and presenting clear, concise risk reports and updates to senior leadership and relevant governance bodies.

  • Partnering with second and third lines of defense to ensure alignment, transparency, and effective challenge, while maintaining strong ownership of risks in the first line.

  • Contributing to the ongoing evolution of the BCO framework at Nu, sharing best practices, proposing improvements, and helping shape how we operate as a global first-line risk team.


We are looking for a person who has

  • Proven experience working with credit card products and businesses, preferably in a global or multi-market environment.

  • Solid experience in non-financial risk management, operational risk, or related risk disciplines within financial services or fintech.

  • Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, governance, and regulatory expectations for consumer credit products.

  • Experience designing, assessing, and improving processes and internal controls, including documentation and process mapping.

  • Proven ability to influence and build strong relationships with stakeholders at different levels of the organization, including senior leaders.

  • A hands-on, ownership-driven mindset, with the ability to dive deep into details while keeping a strategic view of risks and priorities.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear actions and decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to convey risk topics in a clear, concise, and structured way.

  • Independence, proactivity, and a strong desire to challenge the status quo and improve how we work.

Nice to have

  • Experience in first-line risk roles directly embedded in business or product teams.

  • Prior exposure to SOX or similar internal control over financial reporting frameworks.

  • Experience working with teams across different countries and cultures.

  • Knowledge of data, analytics, or tooling that can help automate and enhance risk and control monitoring.


Location for this opportunity

Virgínia (DC Metro)



Our Benefits (United States)

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu.

  • Medical Insurance.

  • Dental and Vision Insurance.

  • Life Insurance and AD&D.

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves.

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses.

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program.

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program.

  • 401K.

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account.

  • Work-from-home Allowance.

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.


Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times | week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/.

We offer relocation package for those who are available to be relocated to the DC region.

Learn more about how we build at Nu

Explore how we build products, technology, and experiences at Nu:

  • https://building.nubank.com.br

  • https://youtube.com/@building.nubank

  • https://open.spotify.com/show/4hAJnAkYKXl42hLXa4LmVQ

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here
